gen-gf-baumans-gf-murecho: Baumans draws every stroke at a single thickness, with a gaping c that gives its headings a tubular, mechanical swagger. Murecho keeps its s curves open and modern.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-niramit: Niramit reads clean and businesslike, its curves gaping a little. Baumans does the loud work up top with bent-tubing letterforms, while the body font simply carries the text underneath.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohin: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya, whose c gapes visibly at any size. And Baumans, with its heavy outline of uniform thickness, gives the pair its commanding edge.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Baumans draws a single-weight line, as if a plotter pen traced each letter. And Noto Sans Manichaean answers with e crossbars that open their mouths, handling the running text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-nko: Bold geometry, then open space. Baumans keeps its horizontals as thick as its verticals for headings with presence, and Noto Sans NKo lets you see through its c openings for modern text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Stiff, tubular and loud: that is Baumans, where stems and arcs move in lockstep. Noto Sans Shavian loosens up with rope-like curves that never knot at the ends, so a long page flows easily.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-palanquin: Palanquin brings curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths to the text. But Baumans, with its unit-width stroke throughout, is where the pair gets its distinctive, commanding character.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-pt-sans: Thick tubing up top, easy arcs below. Baumans bends its letterforms like pipe, and PT Sans follows with open c forms that carry a long passage without fuss.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-roboto-flex: Baumans reads like following a single thread, every stroke drawn at one thickness. Roboto Flex sits beneath with a wide slot between the c's two ends, giving the page a modern, approachable ease.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ruluko: Ruluko opens up its c and s generously. Beside Baumans and its constant stroke, a long passage in it feels approachable, unhurried and clean.
